basics.name: Monika Mathur
basics.title: Chartered Accountant & Finance Manager | Global Finance Operations, Controllership & FP&A Leader
basics.summary: Chartered Accountant and global finance leader with comprehensive experience across financial operations, multi-entity controllership, regulatory compliance, process transformation, and executive management reporting for India, UK, and US entities. Focused on architecting scalable, controlled, data-driven operating models that elevate accuracy, governance, cash-flow visibility, and executive decision-making.

bullets: Directing global finance operations, multi-entity financial accounting, and controllership across international digital entertainment business units.
Overseeing consolidated financial reporting, P&L, balance sheet, and MIS dashboards to support executive leadership decision-making and cross-border operational transparency.
Establishing scalable financial control frameworks and automated reconciliation operating models to support rapid global scale.
Leading FP&A processes, cash-flow modeling, and budget vs. actual variance analysis to drive capital efficiency.

Directed enterprise-wide statutory compliance across GST, TDS, Income Tax, and Softex filings for multi-entity operations, eliminating regulatory exposure and achieving a 100% on-time compliance record through automation-driven governance frameworks.

Built scalable financial control systems and standardized accounting operations across AP/AR, reconciliations, and audit workflows, strengthening reporting accuracy, reducing operational errors by 30%, and ensuring full compliance with statutory and corporate governance standards.

Led consolidated financial reporting for India, UK, and US entities, delivering executive-ready P&L statements, balance sheets, cash flow reporting, and MIS dashboards to support strategic decision-making and cross-border financial visibility.

Optimized working capital and revenue operations by driving end-to-end Accounts Receivable transformation, improving collections efficiency, reducing aging receivables, and enhancing organizational cash flow predictability.
Partnered with leadership on financial process modernization initiatives, implementing controls, reconciliation frameworks, and compliance-driven operating models aligned with global best practices.
Managed and mentored high-performing finance teams, driving operational excellence, stakeholder collaboration, and a culture of accountability within fast-paced, high-growth environments.

leadership.details: Architected enterprise-grade internal financial controls, multi-country consolidation protocols, and audit-readiness frameworks across India, UK, and US entities.
Spearheaded modern finance modernization across AP/AR, reconciliations, and executive dashboards by embedding automation, analytics, and operational intelligence.
Managed and coached high-performing finance teams while partnering with C-suite leadership to align financial governance with high-growth business objectives.

Projects & Research.title: Multi-Entity Financial Consolidation & Reporting Model
bullets: Architected multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction consolidation pipeline unifying financials across Indian, UK, and US corporate entities.
Delivered executive-grade monthly MIS dashboards, balance sheets, and real-time cash flow visibility for senior leadership.
Streamlined intercompany reconciliations and elimination entries to ensure accurate cross-border reporting.

Projects & Research.title: Enterprise Statutory Compliance Automation Framework
bullets: Designed and rolled out an automated governance tracking framework for multi-entity statutory filings (GST, TDS, Income Tax, Softex).
Eliminated penalty exposures and achieved a 100% on-time statutory compliance record across all regulatory cycles.
Created verifiable audit trails that accelerated external auditor sign-offs and regulatory validations.

Projects & Research.title: End-to-End Accounts Receivable & Working Capital Optimization
bullets: Led full lifecycle restructuring of Accounts Receivable processes, standardizing invoicing, collection reminders, and dispute workflows.
Substantially reduced aging receivables and improved collections velocity across global client contracts.
Enhanced liquidity forecasting accuracy, giving leadership predictable operating cash flow visibility.

Projects & Research.title: Internal Financial Controls (ICoFR) & Audit Readiness Overhaul
bullets: Established standardized accounting controls, verification checks, and segregation of duties across AP, AR, and payroll.
Achieved a 30% reduction in operational and reporting errors through structured monthly reconciliation frameworks.
Secured zero major compliance observations across consecutive statutory and internal audit cycles.

Her strong communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively with teammates and cross-functional teams make her a highly dependable and valuable team member.

testimonials.name: Solon Das
testimonials.title: Data & AI Engineering @Swiss Re | Palantir Foundry | AI Infrastructure & Data Platforms
testimonials.text:
It’s my absolute pleasure to recommend Monika Mathur, a highly skilled and dedicated Chartered Accountant who has been instrumental in managing my financial well-being. Monika's expertise in filing income tax returns, optimizing tax savings, and ensuring compliance is unparalleled. Her meticulous approach and clear communication make the entire process stress-free and efficient.

What sets Monika apart is her ability to go beyond traditional accounting tasks. She has guided me in managing my finances and budgeting, ensuring that my financial goals are not only realistic but also aligned with my personal aspirations. Her strategic insights and practical advices have significantly improved my financial health and given me a sense of security.

Monika is not just a professional but also a compassionate and approachable individual who genuinely cares about her clients' success. I highly recommend her to anyone seeking expert financial guidance or support in achieving their financial goals. Thank you, Monika, for making a real difference in my financial journey!
